MASTER-OAFA robotic telescope  [1]  located in Argentina (OAFA observatory of San Juan National University) was pointed to the LAT GRB260708.42 (trigger No 805198281,15h 02m 26.40s , -44d 04m 12.0s, R=0.369833) errorbox  23412 sec after notice time and 44923 sec after trigger time at 2026-07-08 22:40:00 UT, with upper limit up to  18.6 mag. Observations started at twilight.  The observations began at zenith distance = 25 deg. The sun  altitude  is -11.4 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 12 deg., longitude l = 327 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3420593
